title: 潜在暗流：普通拼写错误如何破坏探针检测
summary: 研究发现，普通拼写错误会显著旋转LLM隐藏状态中的探针读出向量（43-56度），并在约10个token内衰减至15%以下。每消息叠加约3个常见拼写错误会使单位置提示注入探针的TPR@FPR=1%下降12个百分点。作者提出KV-cache fork方法，通过追加固定后缀读取扰动下游token，弥补95%的性能差距。
summary_en: LLMs handle typos fluently, but hidden-state probes detecting malicious prompts are fragile: a single typo rotates the readout vector by 43-56 degrees, decaying below 15% within ~10 tokens. Stacking ~3 typos cuts a single-position prompt-injection probe's TPR@FPR=1% by 12.0pp. The authors introduce a KV-cache fork—appending a short fixed suffix after the user message—to read downstream tokens, closing 95% of the gap (-0.6pp residual), far better than perturbation-augmented training (-3.7pp).
